1	"""The costing engine (PLAN 5.3, D-020/D-037): moving-average AND FIFO valuation per (item,
2	warehouse), computed in the SAME transaction as the stock move, right after the quant update and
3	BEFORE the move's costing event is published.
4	
5	The move ledger + quants stay the QUANTITY SSOT; ``inv_item_valuations`` (moving-average) and
6	``inv_cost_layers`` + ``inv_layer_consumptions`` (FIFO) are the VALUE SSOT (D-037). Which engine a
7	(item, warehouse) uses is the item's ``costing_method``.
8	
9	``apply_costing`` is the single entry point ``create_move`` calls. It:
10	1. resolves the move's direction + warehouse(s) from its bins,
11	2. runs the moving-average or FIFO update (receipt adds value, issue computes + removes it),
12	3. writes the computed cost back onto the move (``unit_cost``),
13	4. returns a ``CostingResult`` carrying the ``StockValued`` event (or None for a value-neutral
14	   within-warehouse transfer) for ``create_move`` to publish.
15	
16	Reversal: ``reverse_costing`` undoes a move's valuation symmetrically — a reversed ISSUE replays its
17	FIFO consumptions backward / re-adds moving-average value; a reversed RECEIPT zeros its layer /
18	removes moving-average value. The reversing move publishes the OPPOSITE costing event so the COGS
19	journal is reversed too.
20	
21	The moving-average row math lives in ``costing_mav.py`` and the FIFO layer mechanics in
22	``costing_fifo.py`` (split at the 400-line cap); this file owns the orchestration + reversal
23	sequencing + the StockValued event build.
24	"""
25	
26	from __future__ import annotations
27	
28	import uuid
29	from dataclasses import dataclass
30	from decimal import Decimal
31	
32	from sqlalchemy import select
33	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
34	
35	from app.core.exceptions import ValidationFailedError
36	from app.modules.finance import queries as finance_queries
37	from app.modules.inventory import queries as inventory_queries
38	from app.modules.inventory.constants import (
39	    DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY,
40	    CostingMethod,
41	    MoveType,
42	)
43	from app.modules.inventory.events import StockValued
44	from app.modules.inventory.models import Bin, Item, StockMove
45	from app.modules.inventory.service import costing_fifo, costing_mav
46	
47	
48	@dataclass(frozen=True)
49	class CostingResult:
50	    """What ``apply_costing`` produced for one move: the computed unit cost (written onto the move)
51	    and the ``StockValued`` event to publish (None when the move moved no value — a within-warehouse
52	    transfer — so no journal is posted, D-037)."""
53	
54	    unit_cost: Decimal | None
55	    event: StockValued | None
56	
57	
58	async def _warehouse_of_bin(
59	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bin_id: uuid.UUID
60	) -> uuid.UUID:
61	    """The warehouse a bin belongs to (valuation is per warehouse, not per bin — D-037). The bin was
62	    already validated by the move engine, so a missing one here is an invariant break, not user
63	    input."""
64	    warehouse_id = (
65	        await session.execute(
66	            select(Bin.warehouse_id).where(
67	                Bin.tenant_id == tenant_id, Bin.id == bin_id
68	            )
69	        )
70	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
71	    if warehouse_id is None:
72	        raise ValidationFailedError(
73	            message="The bin has no warehouse for valuation",
74	            code="inventory.costing_bin_warehouse_missing",
75	            details={"bin_id": str(bin_id)},
76	        )
77	    return warehouse_id
78	
79	
80	async def _costing_currency(session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:
81	    """The currency the COGS/inventory journal posts in (D-015): the tenant's functional currency
82	    when configured, else the v1 single-currency default. Costs quantize to its decimals."""
83	    func_code = await finance_queries.functional_currency_or_none(session, tenant_id)
84	    return func_code or DEFAULT_COSTING_CURRENCY
85	
86	
87	async def _category_accounts(
88	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
89	) -> tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID]:
90	    """The item category's three GL account ids (inventory, COGS, price-difference), REQUIRED before
91	    a stocked move can value (D-020/D-029). A STOCKED item whose category has not wired them cannot
92	    post a move — the value would have nowhere to land — so this raises a clear 422."""
93	    accounts = await inventory_queries.get_category_accounts(session, tenant_id, item_id)
94	    if accounts is None or any(account_id is None for account_id in accounts):
95	        raise ValidationFailedError(
96	            message="The item's category must wire inventory, COGS and price-difference accounts "
97	            "before stock can be valued",
98	            code="inventory.category_accounts_unwired",
99	            details={"item_id": str(item_id)},
100	        )
101	    return accounts  # type: ignore[return-value]
102	
103	
104	# --- Orchestration ------------------------------------------------------------
105	
106	
107	async def apply_costing(
108	    session: AsyncSession,
109	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
110	    item: Item,
111	    move: StockMove,
112	    *,
113	    valuation_offset_account_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
114	) -> CostingResult:
115	    """Run costing for a just-created move IN THE SAME TRANSACTION (D-020), after the quant update.
116	
117	    Resolves direction + warehouse(s), runs the moving-average or FIFO engine, writes the computed
118	    ``unit_cost`` back onto the move, and returns the ``StockValued`` event for ``create_move`` to
119	    publish (None for a value-neutral within-warehouse transfer). RECEIPT/positive-ADJUSTMENT use
120	    the
121	    move's passed ``unit_cost`` (the entry cost); ISSUE/negative-ADJUSTMENT IGNORE it and
122	    compute.
123	
124	    ``valuation_offset_account_id`` (PLAN 6.3, D-041) OVERRIDES the standard receipt offset
125	    (price-difference) when the caller — the procurement goods-receipt path — supplies the GR/IR
126	    clearing account. Applied only on the inbound (RECEIPT / positive-ADJUSTMENT) side; the
127	    outbound/transfer paths ignore it (they offset to COGS / their own account)."""
128	    move_type = MoveType(move.move_type)
129	    qty = Decimal(move.quantity)
130	    method = CostingMethod(item.costing_method)
131	    currency_code = await _costing_currency(session, tenant_id)
132	    accounts = await _category_accounts(session, tenant_id, item.id)
133	
134	    from_warehouse_id = (
135	        await _warehouse_of_bin(session, tenant_id, move.from_bin_id)
136	        if move.from_bin_id is not None
137	        else None
138	    )
139	    to_warehouse_id = (
140	        await _warehouse_of_bin(session, tenant_id, move.to_bin_id)
141	        if move.to_bin_id is not None
142	        else None
143	    )
144	
145	    if move_type == MoveType.TRANSFER:
146	        return await _apply_transfer(
147	            session, tenant_id, item, move, qty, method, currency_code,
148	            from_warehouse_id, to_warehouse_id,
149	        )
150	
151	    # Direction is structural: a populated to_bin warehouse is inbound (RECEIPT / increase), a
152	    # populated from_bin warehouse is outbound (ISSUE / decrease). ADJUSTMENT sets exactly one side.
153	    if to_warehouse_id is not None:
154	        return await _apply_inbound(
155	            session, tenant_id, item, move, qty, method, to_warehouse_id, accounts,
156	            valuation_offset_account_id=valuation_offset_account_id,
157	        )
158	    if from_warehouse_id is not None:
159	        return await _apply_outbound(
160	            session, tenant_id, item, move, qty, method, currency_code,
161	            from_warehouse_id, accounts,
162	        )
163	    raise ValidationFailedError(
164	        message="The move has no warehouse side to value",
165	        code="inventory.costing_no_side",
166	        details={"move_id": str(move.id)},
167	    )
168	
169	
170	async def _apply_inbound(
171	    session: AsyncSession,
172	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
173	    item: Item,
174	    move: StockMove,
175	    qty: Decimal,
176	    method: CostingMethod,
177	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
178	    accounts: tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID],
179	    *,
180	    valuation_offset_account_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
181	) -> CostingResult:
182	    """RECEIPT / positive ADJUSTMENT: stock enters at the move's REQUIRED ``unit_cost`` (the entry
183	    cost). Updates the moving-average row or creates a FIFO layer, and emits a value-increasing
184	    StockValued event the handler posts as Dr inventory."""
185	    unit_cost = _require_entry_cost(move)
186	    total_cost = qty * unit_cost
187	    if method == CostingMethod.MOVING_AVERAGE:
188	        await costing_mav.mav_receive(session, tenant_id, item.id, warehouse_id, qty, unit_cost)
189	    else:
190	        await costing_fifo.create_layer(
191	            session,
192	            tenant_id,
193	            item_id=item.id,
194	            warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
195	            receipt_move_id=move.id,
196	            received_at=move.move_date,
197	            qty=qty,
198	            unit_cost=unit_cost,
199	        )
200	    move.unit_cost = unit_cost
201	    inventory_account_id, _cogs_account_id, price_diff_account_id = accounts
202	    # A receipt / stock-increase offsets to the price-difference (inventory-adjustment) account by
203	    # default — a STANDALONE receipt (opening balance, manual stock-in) has no procurement GR/IR
204	    # clearing. The procurement goods-receipt path (6.3, D-041) OVERRIDES the offset to its GR/IR
205	    # clearing account via ``valuation_offset_account_id`` so the handler credits GR/IR.
206	    offset_account_id = valuation_offset_account_id or price_diff_account_id
207	    event = _build_event(
208	        move, warehouse_id, qty, total_cost, Decimal(0),
209	        inventory_account_id, offset_account_id, price_diff_account_id,
210	        is_inbound=True,
211	    )
212	    return CostingResult(unit_cost=unit_cost, event=event)
213	
214	
215	async def _apply_outbound(
216	    session: AsyncSession,
217	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
218	    item: Item,
219	    move: StockMove,
220	    qty: Decimal,
221	    method: CostingMethod,
222	    currency_code: str,
223	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
224	    accounts: tuple[uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID, uuid.UUID],
225	) -> CostingResult:
226	    """ISSUE / negative ADJUSTMENT: the engine COMPUTES the cost of the stock that left (the passed
227	    unit_cost is ignored). Moving average quantizes qty × avg + flushes residual at zero on-hand;
228	    FIFO sums per-layer quantized costs. Emits a value-decreasing StockValued event the handler
229	    posts
230	    as Dr COGS / Cr inventory."""
231	    residual_flush = Decimal(0)
232	    if method == CostingMethod.MOVING_AVERAGE:
233	        cogs, residual_flush = await costing_mav.mav_issue(
234	            session, tenant_id, item.id, warehouse_id, qty, currency_code
235	        )
236	    else:
237	        cogs = await costing_fifo.consume_layers(
238	            session,
239	            tenant_id,
240	            item_id=item.id,
241	            warehouse_id=warehouse_id,
242	            issue_move_id=move.id,
243	            qty=qty,
244	            currency_code=currency_code,
245	        )
246	    unit_cost = (cogs / qty) if qty > 0 else Decimal(0)
247	    move.unit_cost = unit_cost
248	    inventory_account_id, cogs_account_id, price_diff_account_id = accounts
249	    # An ISSUE charges COGS (goods left for sale/production); an ADJUSTMENT-down is an inventory
250	    # write-off with no document behind it, so it offsets to the price-difference account (D-020).
251	    offset_account_id = (
252	        cogs_account_id
253	        if MoveType(move.move_type) == MoveType.ISSUE
254	        else price_diff_account_id
255	    )
256	    event = _build_event(
257	        move, warehouse_id, qty, cogs, residual_flush,
258	        inventory_account_id, offset_account_id, price_diff_account_id,
259	        is_inbound=False,
260	    )
261	    return CostingResult(unit_cost=unit_cost, event=event)
262	
263	
264	async def _apply_transfer(
265	    session: AsyncSession,
266	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
267	    item: Item,
268	    move: StockMove,
269	    qty: Decimal,
270	    method: CostingMethod,
271	    currency_code: str,
272	    from_warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None,
273	    to_warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None,
274	) -> CostingResult:
275	    """TRANSFER carries cost at the current valuation. Within ONE warehouse it is fully
276	    value-neutral — the valuation/layers don't change and NO journal is posted (D-037). Between
277	    warehouses the value moves WITH the stock (issue from source at current cost, receive into dest
278	    at that same cost) but, because both warehouses share the one inventory account in v1, the net
279	    journal is still zero — so a transfer never publishes a StockValued event. The computed transfer
280	    unit cost is still written onto the move for the ledger."""
281	    if from_warehouse_id is None or to_warehouse_id is None:
282	        raise ValidationFailedError(
283	            message="A transfer needs both warehouses to value",
284	            code="inventory.costing_transfer_sides",
285	            details={"move_id": str(move.id)},
286	        )
287	    if from_warehouse_id == to_warehouse_id:
288	        # Same warehouse: only the bin changed; value is unchanged. Carry the current cost onto the
289	        # move for the ledger, touch nothing else, post no journal.
290	        move.unit_cost = await _current_unit_cost(
291	            session, tenant_id, item, from_warehouse_id, method
292	        )
293	        return CostingResult(unit_cost=move.unit_cost, event=None)
294	
295	    # Cross-warehouse: remove value from the source and add it to the destination at the SAME cost,
296	    # so the value follows the stock between warehouses while the net GL effect is nil.
297	    if method == CostingMethod.MOVING_AVERAGE:
298	        cost, _residual = await costing_mav.mav_issue(
299	            session, tenant_id, item.id, from_warehouse_id, qty, currency_code
300	        )
301	        unit_cost = (cost / qty) if qty > 0 else Decimal(0)
302	        await costing_mav.mav_receive(
303	            session, tenant_id, item.id, to_warehouse_id, qty, unit_cost
304	        )
305	    else:
306	        cost = await costing_fifo.consume_layers(
307	            session,
308	            tenant_id,
309	            item_id=item.id,
310	            warehouse_id=from_warehouse_id,
311	            issue_move_id=move.id,
312	            qty=qty,
313	            currency_code=currency_code,
314	        )
315	        unit_cost = (cost / qty) if qty > 0 else Decimal(0)
316	        await costing_fifo.create_layer(
317	            session,
318	            tenant_id,
319	            item_id=item.id,
320	            warehouse_id=to_warehouse_id,
321	            receipt_move_id=move.id,
322	            received_at=move.move_date,
323	            qty=qty,
324	            unit_cost=unit_cost,
325	        )
326	    move.unit_cost = unit_cost
327	    return CostingResult(unit_cost=unit_cost, event=None)
328	
329	
330	async def _current_unit_cost(
331	    session: AsyncSession,
332	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
333	    item: Item,
334	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
335	    method: CostingMethod,
336	) -> Decimal:
337	    """The current per-unit cost of an (item, warehouse) for a value-neutral transfer's ledger
338	    entry:
339	    the moving-average avg, or the FIFO weighted average of the live layers. Reads only (no
340	    writes)."""
341	    if method == CostingMethod.MOVING_AVERAGE:
342	        return await costing_mav.mav_avg_cost(session, tenant_id, item.id, warehouse_id)
343	    return await costing_mav.fifo_weighted_cost(session, tenant_id, item.id, warehouse_id)
344	
345	
346	def _require_entry_cost(move: StockMove) -> Decimal:
347	    """A RECEIPT / positive ADJUSTMENT REQUIRES the entry unit_cost (D-020) — without it the value
348	    entering inventory is undefined. Validated at the service edge (create_move) too; this is the
349	    last guard before the value lands."""
350	    if move.unit_cost is None:
351	        raise ValidationFailedError(
352	            message="A receipt requires a unit cost (the value at which stock enters)",
353	            code="inventory.receipt_unit_cost_required",
354	            details={"move_id": str(move.id)},
355	        )
356	    return Decimal(move.unit_cost)
357	
358	
359	def _build_event(
360	    move: StockMove,
361	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
362	    qty: Decimal,
363	    total_cost: Decimal,
364	    residual_flush: Decimal,
365	    inventory_account_id: uuid.UUID,
366	    offset_account_id: uuid.UUID,
367	    price_diff_account_id: uuid.UUID,
368	    *,
369	    is_inbound: bool,
370	) -> StockValued:
371	    return StockValued(
372	        tenant_id=move.tenant_id,
373	        move_id=move.id,
374	        move_number=move.move_number,
375	        move_type=move.move_type,
376	        is_inbound=is_inbound,
377	        item_id=move.item_id,

93	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID

99	    stmt = (

104	        )

117	    models. Existence only — the move engine re-checks the bin is in an ACTIVE warehouse when it

162	    ``(tenant_id, item_id)``."""

169	async def on_hand(
170	    session: AsyncSession,
171	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
172	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
173	    bin_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
174	    lot_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
175	) -> Decimal:
176	    """On-hand quantity of an item, optionally narrowed to one bin and/or one lot (PLAN 5.2). With
177	    no bin/lot this is ``total_on_hand``; with a bin it is that bin's stock; with a lot it is that
178	    lot's stock (in the bin if also given). Reads the maintained projection."""
179	    stmt = select(func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)).where(
180	        StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id
181	    )
182	    if bin_id is not None:
183	        stmt = stmt.where(StockQuant.bin_id == bin_id)
184	    if lot_id is not None:

189	async def items_below_reorder_point(
190	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID
191	) -> list[tuple[uuid.UUID, Decimal, Decimal, Decimal]]:
192	    """Items whose total on-hand is AT OR BELOW their reorder point (PLAN 6.4, D-042) — the
193	    consumption-based replenishment scan. Returns ``(item_id, on_hand, reorder_point,
194	    reorder_quantity)`` for each ACTIVE item that carries a positive reorder point, has a positive
195	    reorder quantity, and whose on-hand (the maintained ``inv_stock_quants`` projection, summed per
196	    item) has fallen to or under that point. Procurement's reorder scan turns each into a draft
197	    requisition line for ``reorder_quantity``.
198	
199	    SET-BASED (no per-item N+1, PERFORMANCE §2): the on-hand sum is a LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY over the
200	    quant projection (items with no stock read 0 via coalesce), and the reorder predicate filters in
201	    SQL. Inventory OWNS reorder_point/reorder_quantity (5.1); the DRAFT requisition is a procurement
202	    document (6.2) — this query is the contract procurement reads, never importing inventory
203	    models."""
204	    on_hand_sum = func.coalesce(func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty), 0)
205	    stmt = (
206	        select(
207	            Item.id,
208	            on_hand_sum.label("on_hand"),
209	            Item.reorder_point,
210	            Item.reorder_quantity,
211	        )
212	        .join(
213	            StockQuant,
214	            (StockQuant.tenant_id == Item.tenant_id) & (StockQuant.item_id == Item.id),
215	            isouter=True,
216	        )
217	        .where(
218	            Item.tenant_id == tenant_id,
219	            Item.is_active.is_(True),
220	            Item.reorder_point.is_not(None),
221	            Item.reorder_point > 0,
222	            Item.reorder_quantity.is_not(None),
223	            Item.reorder_quantity > 0,
224	        )
225	        .group_by(Item.id, Item.reorder_point, Item.reorder_quantity)
226	        .having(on_hand_sum <= Item.reorder_point)
227	        .order_by(Item.item_code)
228	    )
229	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()
230	    return [
231	        (row[0], Decimal(row[1]), Decimal(row[2]), Decimal(row[3]))
232	        for row in rows
233	    ]

236	async def on_hand_by_bin(
237	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
238	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
239	    """Per-bin on-hand totals for an item (PLAN 5.2): ``{bin_id: qty}`` summed across that bin's
240	    lots. Bins with zero net stock are absent (the move service deletes a quant when it hits 0, so
241	    the projection holds only live stock). What a bin-level stock-overview screen reads."""
242	    stmt = (
243	        select(StockQuant.bin_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
244	        .where(StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id, StockQuant.item_id == item_id)
245	        .group_by(StockQuant.bin_id)
246	    )

251	async def on_hand_by_lot(
252	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID
253	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
254	    """Per-lot on-hand totals for a LOT-tracked item (PLAN 5.2): ``{lot_id: qty}`` summed across
255	    bins. Quants with a NULL lot (fungible stock) are excluded — this view is for tracked items
256	    where lot traceability matters."""
257	    stmt = (
258	        select(StockQuant.lot_id, func.sum(StockQuant.on_hand_qty))
259	        .where(
260	            StockQuant.tenant_id == tenant_id,
261	            StockQuant.item_id == item_id,
262	            StockQuant.lot_id.is_not(None),
263	        )
264	        .group_by(StockQuant.lot_id)
265	    )
266	    rows = (await session.execute(stmt)).all()

269	
270	# --- Valuation reads (PLAN 5.3, D-020/D-037) ----------------------------------
271	# These read the VALUE SSOT (inv_item_valuations for moving-average, inv_cost_layers for FIFO), kept
272	# in lock-step with every move in the same transaction (D-037). The inventory-value dashboard KPI
273	# and
274	# valuation reports read these. MoneyType/QuantityType propagation keeps the SUMs exact (D-015).
275	
276	
277	async def item_value(
278	    session: AsyncSession,
279	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
280	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
281	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
282	) -> Decimal:
283	    """The current total inventory VALUE of an item (PLAN 5.3), optionally narrowed to one
284	    warehouse.
285	
286	    For a MOVING_AVERAGE item this sums ``inv_item_valuations.total_value``; for a FIFO item it sums
287	    ``remaining_qty × unit_cost`` over the live cost layers. An item uses exactly one method, so the
288	    other source contributes 0. The FIFO product is summed in PYTHON (each factor already a typed
289	    Decimal) rather than ``func.sum(qty × cost)``, because multiplying two scaled-integer columns on
290	    SQLite yields a ×10^12 value that the MoneyType result processor cannot un-scale (D-015 trigger
291	    discipline: SQL never multiplies two stored money/quantity columns)."""
292	    valuation_stmt = select(
293	        func.coalesce(func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value), 0)
294	    ).where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id, ItemValuation.item_id == item_id)
295	    layer_stmt = select(CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
296	        CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id,
297	        CostLayer.item_id == item_id,
298	        CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0,
299	    )
300	    if warehouse_id is not None:
301	        valuation_stmt = valuation_stmt.where(ItemValuation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
302	        layer_stmt = layer_stmt.where(CostLayer.warehouse_id == warehouse_id)
303	    mav_value = Decimal((await session.execute(valuation_stmt)).scalar_one())
304	    fifo_value = sum(
305	        (Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost) for qty, cost in (await session.execute(layer_stmt)).all()),
306	        Decimal(0),
307	    )
308	    return mav_value + fifo_value
309	
310	
311	async def valuation_summary(
312	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID
313	) -> dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal]:
314	    """Total inventory value per item across the tenant (PLAN 5.3): ``{item_id: value}`` — the
315	    moving-average totals plus the FIFO live-layer values, merged per item. What the inventory-value
316	    dashboard KPI sums. The moving-average totals are grouped in SQL; the FIFO layer products are
317	    summed in Python per item (D-015: no SQL multiply of two scaled money/quantity columns).
318	    PERFORMANCE §6: two reads, no per-item N+1."""
319	    mav_rows = (
320	        await session.execute(
321	            select(ItemValuation.item_id, func.sum(ItemValuation.total_value))
322	            .where(ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id)
323	            .group_by(ItemValuation.item_id)
324	        )
325	    ).all()
326	    layer_rows = (
327	        await session.execute(
328	            select(CostLayer.item_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
329	                CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id, CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0
330	            )
331	        )
332	    ).all()
333	    totals: dict[uuid.UUID, Decimal] = {}
334	    for item_id_, value in mav_rows:
335	        if value is not None:
336	            totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(value)
337	    for item_id_, qty, cost in layer_rows:
338	        totals[item_id_] = totals.get(item_id_, Decimal(0)) + Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost)
339	    return totals
340	
341	
342	async def current_unit_cost(
343	    session: AsyncSession,
344	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
345	    item_id: uuid.UUID,
346	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID,
347	) -> Decimal:
348	    """The item's current per-unit BOOK cost in a warehouse (PLAN 5.4): the moving-average
349	    ``avg_unit_cost`` for a MOVING_AVERAGE item, or the weighted average of the live FIFO layers for
350	    a FIFO item — the SAME source a value-neutral transfer uses for its ledger cost
351	    (costing._current_unit_cost). A positive count variance enters stock at this cost so the value
352	    added matches the book cost (rather than an arbitrary entry price). Returns 0 when no
353	    valuation/layer exists yet (an item the system thinks is empty, counted positive — the
354	    adjustment then enters at 0 cost, a quantity-only correction with no value impact, which the
355	    operator can re-cost via a later receipt). The FIFO layer product is summed in PYTHON (D-015: no
356	    SQL multiply of two scaled money/quantity columns). One read for the MAV row, one for the FIFO
357	    layers (no per-layer N+1)."""
358	    valuation = (
359	        await session.execute(
360	            select(ItemValuation.avg_unit_cost).where(
361	                ItemValuation.tenant_id == tenant_id,
362	                ItemValuation.item_id == item_id,
363	                ItemValuation.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
364	            )
365	        )
366	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
367	    if valuation is not None:
368	        return Decimal(valuation)
369	    rows = (
370	        await session.execute(
371	            select(CostLayer.remaining_qty, CostLayer.unit_cost).where(
372	                CostLayer.tenant_id == tenant_id,
373	                CostLayer.item_id == item_id,
374	                CostLayer.warehouse_id == warehouse_id,
375	                CostLayer.remaining_qty > 0,
376	            )
377	        )
378	    ).all()
379	    total_qty = sum((Decimal(qty) for qty, _cost in rows), Decimal(0))
380	    total_value = sum((Decimal(qty) * Decimal(cost) for qty, cost in rows), Decimal(0))
381	    return (total_value / total_qty) if total_qty > 0 else Decimal(0)
382

1	"""Domain events inventory PUBLISHES (D-011/D-020). Declarative data only — no logic, no models —
2	so finance's ``handlers.py`` may import these typed classes (the STRUCTURE §5 events.py allowance,
3	explicitly covering finance importing "upward" from inventory because events carry no behaviour).
4	
5	``StockValued`` is fired inside ``create_move`` AFTER the move + quant + valuation/layer updates,
6	carrying the computed value delta and the THREE GL account ids resolved from the item's category at
7	publish time (D-029 opaque ids). ``finance/handlers.py`` subscribes and posts the COGS/inventory
8	journal in the SAME transaction (D-011/D-020), so the move and its journal commit or roll back as
9	one
10	— a stock move can never exist without its journal entry, or vice versa.
11	
12	ONE event for every value-changing move; the handler branches on ``move_type`` for the per-type
13	postings (RECEIPT / ISSUE / ADJUSTMENT up/down). A value-neutral within-warehouse TRANSFER does NOT
14	publish (no value change → no journal). All amounts are full-precision Decimals; the handler
15	quantizes
16	the posted COGS to the currency's decimals (D-015).
17	"""
18	
19	import uuid
20	from decimal import Decimal
21	from typing import ClassVar
22	
23	from app.core.events import DomainEvent
24	from app.modules.inventory.constants import STOCK_VALUED_EVENT_KEY
25	
26	
27	class StockValued(DomainEvent):
28	    """A stock move changed valuation (D-020). Payload:
29	
30	    - ``move_id`` + ``move_date`` + ``move_number`` — the driving move (the journal posts with
31	      ``move_date``; a date in a CLOSED period makes the journal's period trigger fire inside the
32	      same transaction, rolling the whole move back — you cannot move stock into a closed period).
33	    - ``move_type`` — RECEIPT / ISSUE / ADJUSTMENT (the handler branches on it; TRANSFER within one
34	      warehouse never publishes). ``is_inbound`` disambiguates an ADJUSTMENT's direction (increase
35	      vs decrease) since both carry move_type ADJUSTMENT.
36	    - ``item_id`` + ``warehouse_id`` + ``quantity`` — the dimensions copied onto the COGS journal
37	      line (item dimension) and the value context.
38	    - ``total_cost`` — the value Δ the move moved (positive): RECEIPT entry value, ISSUE/decrease
39	      computed COGS, increase value. ``residual_to_price_difference`` is the moving-average
40	      zero-quantity flush amount (signed, usually 0) the handler posts to price-difference WITHIN
41	      the issue's entry so value and quantity never disagree (D-020).
42	    - ``document_id`` — the move's core_documents id (the docflow source ref the handler links the
43	      journal entry to, link_type 'posts').
44	    - ``inventory_account_id`` + ``offset_account_id`` — the two legs of the main posting: inventory
45	      is always one side; the OFFSET is chosen by the costing engine per move type (ISSUE -> COGS;
46	      RECEIPT / ADJUSTMENT -> price-difference; a reversal -> the OPPOSITE of the original move's
47	      offset, so reversing an issue credits COGS and reversing a receipt debits price-difference).
48	      ``is_inbound`` picks the Dr/Cr direction: inbound = Dr inventory / Cr offset.
49	    - ``price_difference_account_id`` — where the moving-average zero-quantity residual flush lands
50	      (always price-difference), separate from the main offset."""
51	
52	    key: ClassVar[str] = STOCK_VALUED_EVENT_KEY
53	
54	    move_id: uuid.UUID
55	    move_number: str
56	    move_type: str
57	    is_inbound: bool
58	    item_id: uuid.UUID
59	    warehouse_id: uuid.UUID
60	    quantity: Decimal
61	    total_cost: Decimal
62	    residual_to_price_difference: Decimal
63	    move_date: str
64	    document_id: uuid.UUID
65	    inventory_account_id: uuid.UUID
66	    offset_account_id: uuid.UUID
67	    price_difference_account_id: uuid.UUID
68	
69	
70	__all__ = ["StockValued"]

1	"""Manufacturing constants (STRUCTURE §3): the BOM/routing status enums and the permission keys,
2	registered into the core RBAC catalog at import (D-009).
3	
4	A SINGLE file (STRUCTURE §8.4: split into a constants/ package only at the 400-line cap, the
5	inventory precedent) — PLAN 8.1's masters sit well under that. Production orders (8.2) and MRP (8.3)
6	will add their own document types / number sequences / event keys; if that pushes this past the cap
7	it becomes a constants/ package then, the sales precedent.
8	
9	IDENTITY + NUMBERING (decided here, D-047). Manufacturing MASTERS carry no gapless document number:
10	
11	- **Work centres** and the BOM/routing CODE-bearing identity follow the master-data precedent
12	  (item_code / vendor_code / customer_code): ``work_center_code`` is USER-SUPPLIED and unique per
13	  tenant (``UNIQUE(tenant_id, code)``). A code, not a gapless number.
14	- **A BOM is identified by ``(item_id, version)``** — the item it PRODUCES plus a user-supplied
15	  version string — NOT a standalone code, mirroring S/4HANA's "BOM is keyed by material + BOM
16	  usage/alternative". ``UNIQUE(tenant_id, item_id, version)``. The same shape is used for routings
17	  for consistency: a routing is ``(item_id, version)`` too (NOT a routing_code), so BOM and routing
18	  identity read identically and a routing can be looked up the same way a BOM is.
19	
20	There is deliberately NO auto-sequence here: a master carries a stable user-chosen handle, never a
21	gapless number. The PRODUCTION ORDERS in 8.2 WILL register documents and claim a gapless number (a
22	posted document in the D-012 sense) — but the masters do not.
23	
24	ACTIVATION MODEL (D-047). A BOM/routing version has a lifecycle status (DRAFT|ACTIVE|INACTIVE):
25	
26	- **DRAFT** — editable: components/operations may be added, changed and removed. A new version is
27	  born DRAFT.
28	- **ACTIVE** — usable by production/MRP and FROZEN: its components/operations can no longer be
29	  changed (corrections are a NEW version, the append-only-master philosophy). At most ONE
30	  ACTIVE+``is_default`` version per item — the one ``get_active_bom_for_item`` /
31	  ``get_active_routing_for_item`` resolve (8.2/8.3 read this). Activating a version that becomes the
32	  new default first demotes the previously-default ACTIVE version's ``is_default`` flag.
33	- **INACTIVE** — retired: a once-ACTIVE version superseded by a newer one; kept for history /
34	  referenceability, never deleted.
35	
36	"MULTI-LEVEL via references" (D-047). The SCHEMA is single-level-per-BOM: a ``Bom`` header lists the
37	DIRECT components of one parent item. "Multi-level" emerges because a component item can itself be
38	the parent of its OWN ``Bom`` — the tree is resolved by EXPLOSION at MRP time (8.3), which walks
39	component item -> its active BOM -> its components recursively. A direct self-component (a component
40	whose item IS the BOM's parent) is rejected at the masters here; deeper cycle prevention (A needs B
41	needs A) is a 8.3 explosion-time concern (the explosion carries a visited set + depth cap, the
42	docflow get_chain precedent), not enforceable on a single-level row.
43	"""
44	
45	from enum import StrEnum
46	
47	from app.core.rbac import register_permissions
48	
49	
50	class BomStatus(StrEnum):
51	    """Lifecycle of a BOM VERSION (D-047). A BOM is activated to become usable by production/MRP.
52	
53	    - DRAFT: editable — components may be added/changed/removed. A new version starts here.
54	    - ACTIVE: usable by 8.2/8.3 and FROZEN — components are immutable; at most one ACTIVE+default
55	      version per item (the one MRP/production resolve).
56	    - INACTIVE: retired — a superseded version, kept for history, never deleted.
57	    """
58	
59	    DRAFT = "DRAFT"
60	    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
61	    INACTIVE = "INACTIVE"
62	
63	
64	class RoutingStatus(StrEnum):
65	    """Lifecycle of a ROUTING VERSION (D-047) — the routing twin of ``BomStatus``, identical
66	    semantics so BOM and routing activation read the same:
67	
68	    - DRAFT: editable — operations may be added/changed/removed.
69	    - ACTIVE: usable by 8.2/8.3 and FROZEN — operations are immutable; at most one ACTIVE+default
70	      version per item.
71	    - INACTIVE: retired — kept for history, never deleted.
72	    """
73	
74	    DRAFT = "DRAFT"
75	    ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
76	    INACTIVE = "INACTIVE"
77	
78	
79	# --- Permissions (D-009): one key per guarded endpoint action -----------------
80	# read vs manage on each of the three masters. "manage" covers create/edit/activate/deactivate —
81	# activation is part of authoring a BOM/routing, not a separate privileged posting like
82	# journal.post (a BOM activation drives no GL effect), so it rides the manage key rather than its
83	# own. A separate key can be carved out later if activation needs segregation-of-duties.
84	MFG_BOM_READ = "manufacturing.bom.read"

1	"""Bill-of-materials master (PLAN 8.1, parity PP BOMs multi-level + versioned = FULL).
2	
3	A BOM is the recipe for ONE parent item: a header (``Bom``) plus its direct ``BomComponent`` lines.
4	Identity is ``(item_id, version)`` (D-047) — the item it PRODUCES plus a user-supplied version
5	string — so a material can have several BOM versions, exactly one of which is the ACTIVE default
6	8.2/8.3 resolve. "Multi-level" is via REFERENCES: a component item can itself be the parent of its
7	own BOM, and the tree is walked by explosion at MRP time (8.3); the schema is single-level-per-BOM.
8	
9	The item/UoM ids on the header and the component item/UoM ids on the lines are OPAQUE inventory ids
10	(D-029): no cross-module FK to inv_items/inv_uoms; the service validates each via
11	``inventory/queries`` before writing. Quantities use the D-015 QuantityType (scale-6, exact on both
12	engines); scrap_percent is a QuantityType ratio (never a plain Numeric, which loses precision on
13	SQLite, D-015).
14	"""
15	
16	import uuid
17	from decimal import Decimal
18	
19	import sqlalchemy as sa
20	from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column
21	
22	from app.core.models import (
23	    AuditMixin,
24	    Base,
25	    TenantMixin,
26	    TimestampMixin,
27	    UuidPKMixin,
28	    tenant_fk,
29	    tenant_unique,
30	)
31	from app.core.money import QuantityType
32	from app.modules.manufacturing.constants import BomStatus
33	
34	
35	class Bom(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, AuditMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
36	    """A BOM HEADER — one VERSION of the recipe for a parent item (D-047).
37	
38	    Identity ``(item_id, version)``: ``item_id`` is the OPAQUE inventory item the BOM PRODUCES (the
39	    finished/parent item, validated via inventory/queries); ``version`` is a user-supplied string
40	    (e.g. "1", "1.0", "REV-A"). ``base_quantity`` is how many parent units this BOM yields (e.g. 1);
41	    component ``quantity_per`` is per ``base_quantity``. ``status`` (BomStatus) gates usability;
42	    ``is_default`` marks the version 8.2/8.3 resolve — at most ONE ACTIVE+default per item, enforced
43	    in the service. Audited (D-010): the BOM defines what a production order consumes.
44	    """
45	
46	    __tablename__ = "mfg_boms"
47	    __table_args__ = (
48	        sa.UniqueConstraint(
49	            "tenant_id", "item_id", "version", name="uq_mfg_boms_tenant_id_item_id_version"
50	        ),
51	        tenant_unique(),
52	        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
53	        sa.CheckConstraint("base_quantity > 0", name="ck_mfg_boms_base_quantity_positive"),
54	        # The default-active resolver + the filtered list both key on (tenant, item_id, status)
55	        # (PERFORMANCE §6); this composite serves get_active_bom_for_item + the item/status filter.
56	        sa.Index(
57	            "ix_mfg_boms_tenant_id_item_id_status", "tenant_id", "item_id", "status"
58	        ),
59	    )
60	
61	    # OPAQUE inventory item id (D-029): the parent item the BOM produces. No FK to inv_items.
62	    item_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
63	    version: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(40), nullable=False)
64	    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(200), nullable=False)
65	    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
66	        sa.String(20), nullable=False, default=BomStatus.DRAFT.value, server_default="DRAFT"
67	    )
68	    base_quantity: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
69	        QuantityType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(1), server_default="1"
70	    )
71	    # OPAQUE inventory UoM id (D-029): the parent's unit, the base_quantity is expressed in.
72	    uom_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
73	    is_default: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(
74	        sa.Boolean, nullable=False, default=False, server_default=sa.false()
75	    )
76	    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(sa.String(1000), nullable=True)
77	
78	
79	class BomComponent(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
80	    """One DIRECT component line of a BOM (D-047): a raw material or sub-assembly consumed to make
81	    the parent.
82	
83	    ``component_item_id`` is an OPAQUE inventory item (validated via inventory/queries) that MUST
84	    differ from the BOM's parent item — a direct self-component is rejected (the service enforces
85	    it; deeper cycles are an 8.3 explosion-time concern). ``quantity_per`` is the quantity consumed
86	    per the header's ``base_quantity`` of parent; ``scrap_percent`` adds waste allowance (0 = none).
87	    A component item that itself has a BOM is the "multi-level via references" mechanism — resolved
88	    by explosion in 8.3.
89	
90	    NOT AuditMixin: components are low-churn config that ride the BOM header's audit story (no
91	    independent lifecycle) — the inventory UomConversion precedent, keeping the audit log lean.
92	    """
93	
94	    __tablename__ = "mfg_bom_components"
95	    __table_args__ = (
96	        sa.UniqueConstraint(
97	            "tenant_id",
98	            "bom_id",
99	            "line_number",
100	            name="uq_mfg_bom_components_tenant_id_bom_id_line_number",
101	        ),
102	        tenant_unique(),
103	        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
104	        tenant_fk("mfg_boms", "bom_id"),
105	        sa.CheckConstraint(
106	            "quantity_per > 0", name="ck_mfg_bom_components_quantity_per_positive"
107	        ),
108	        sa.CheckConstraint(
109	            "scrap_percent >= 0", name="ck_mfg_bom_components_scrap_non_negative"
110	        ),
111	        # The "this BOM's components" read path (the nested list + explosion).
112	        sa.Index("ix_mfg_bom_components_tenant_id_bom_id", "tenant_id", "bom_id"),
113	    )
114	
115	    bom_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
116	    line_number: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(sa.Integer, nullable=False)
117	    # OPAQUE inventory item id (D-029): the component material/sub-assembly. No FK to inv_items.
118	    component_item_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
119	    quantity_per: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(QuantityType(), nullable=False)
120	    # OPAQUE inventory UoM id (D-029): the unit quantity_per is expressed in.
121	    uom_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
122	    scrap_percent: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
123	        QuantityType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(0), server_default="0"
124	    )
125	    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(sa.String(1000), nullable=True)

"""Purpose-keyed account wiring (D-019), split out of service/fx.py to keep both under the cap.

A ``PostingDefault`` maps a purpose string (e.g. ``'fx_unrealized_gain'``) to a GL account, so any
flow that must post to a CONFIGURED account resolves it data-driven rather than hard-coding an
account code. The FX engine is the first consumer (gain/loss + revaluation adjustment); AP/AR and
inventory COGS reuse the same mechanism in later phases. Kept a distinct concern file (not in
fx.py) because it is account wiring, not FX rate math.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

1	"""BOM business logic (PLAN 8.1, D-047): header + component CRUD, activate/deactivate.
2	
3	Rules enforced here (the service owns them, CLAUDE.md rule 7):
4	
5	- **Identity ``(item_id, version)``** — a duplicate (item, version) is a ConflictError before the DB
6	  UNIQUE would raise. The parent ``item_id`` and ``uom_id`` are OPAQUE inventory ids validated via
7	  ``inventory/queries`` (D-029); a component ``component_item_id``/``uom_id`` likewise.
8	- **No self-component** — a component item that IS the BOM's parent item is rejected. Deeper
9	  multi-level cycles (A→B→A) are an 8.3 explosion-time concern (visited set + depth cap), not
10	  enforceable on a single-level row.
11	- **DRAFT-editable, then ACTIVE-frozen (D-047)** — the header and its components may be changed only
12	  while the BOM is DRAFT. Once ACTIVE the recipe is frozen: corrections are a NEW version. Editing /
13	  adding / deleting a component on a non-DRAFT BOM is a ConflictError.
14	- **Single ACTIVE default per item** — activating a BOM makes it the item's default and demotes any
15	  previously-default ACTIVE version's ``is_default`` flag, so exactly one default-active version
16	  exists per item.
17	
18	``from __future__ import annotations`` keeps ``Page[Bom]`` (the ORM model) a string at import.
19	"""
20	
21	from __future__ import annotations
22	
23	import uuid
24	
25	from sqlalchemy import func, select
26	from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
27	
28	from app.core.exceptions import ConflictError, NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
29	from app.core.pagination import DEFAULT_LIMIT, OrderKey, SortDirection, filter_fingerprint, paginate
30	from app.core.schemas import Page
31	from app.modules.inventory import queries as inventory_queries
32	from app.modules.manufacturing.constants import BomStatus
33	from app.modules.manufacturing.models import Bom, BomComponent
34	from app.modules.manufacturing.schemas import BomComponentCreate, BomCreate, BomUpdate

37	async def _require_item(session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
38	    """The opaque inventory item must exist (D-029) — validated via inventory/queries."""
39	    if not await inventory_queries.item_exists(session, tenant_id, item_id):
40	        raise ValidationFailedError(
41	            message="Referenced inventory item does not exist",
42	            code="manufacturing.item_not_found",
43	            details={"item_id": str(item_id)},
44	        )
45	
46	
47	async def _require_uom(session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, uom_id: uuid.UUID) -> None:
48	    """The opaque inventory UoM must exist (D-029) — validated via inventory/queries (a UoM is a
49	    distinct inventory entity from an item, so it has its own existence check)."""
50	    if not await inventory_queries.uom_exists(session, tenant_id, uom_id):
51	        raise ValidationFailedError(
52	            message="Referenced unit of measure does not exist",
53	            code="manufacturing.uom_not_found",
54	            details={"uom_id": str(uom_id)},
55	        )
56	
57	
58	async def get_bom(session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bom_id: uuid.UUID) -> Bom:
59	    bom = await session.get(Bom, bom_id)
60	    if bom is None or bom.tenant_id != tenant_id:
61	        raise NotFoundError(message="BOM not found", code="manufacturing.bom_not_found")
62	    return bom
63	
64	
65	async def create_bom(session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, payload: BomCreate) -> Bom:
66	    """Create a BOM header (born DRAFT). Validates the parent item + UoM exist; rejects a duplicate
67	    (item, version)."""
68	    await _require_item(session, tenant_id, payload.item_id)
69	    await _require_uom(session, tenant_id, payload.uom_id)
70	    existing = (
71	        await session.execute(
72	            select(Bom.id).where(
73	                Bom.tenant_id == tenant_id,
74	                Bom.item_id == payload.item_id,
75	                Bom.version == payload.version,
76	            )
77	        )
78	    ).first()
79	    if existing is not None:
80	        raise ConflictError(
81	            message=f"A BOM for this item with version {payload.version} already exists",
82	            code="manufacturing.bom_version_conflict",
83	            details={"item_id": str(payload.item_id), "version": payload.version},
84	        )
85	    bom = Bom(
86	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
87	        item_id=payload.item_id,
88	        version=payload.version,
89	        name=payload.name,
90	        status=BomStatus.DRAFT.value,
91	        base_quantity=payload.base_quantity,
92	        uom_id=payload.uom_id,
93	        is_default=False,
94	        notes=payload.notes,
95	    )
96	    session.add(bom)
97	    await session.flush()
98	    return bom
99	
100	
101	async def update_bom(
102	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bom_id: uuid.UUID, payload: BomUpdate
103	) -> Bom:
104	    """Partial update of a BOM header — only while DRAFT (D-047). ``item_id``/``version`` are
105	    immutable; a changed ``uom_id`` is re-validated. A non-DRAFT BOM is frozen (ConflictError)."""
106	    bom = await get_bom(session, tenant_id, bom_id)
107	    if bom.status != BomStatus.DRAFT.value:
108	        raise ConflictError(
109	            message="Only a DRAFT BOM can be edited; create a new version to change an active BOM",
110	            code="manufacturing.bom_not_draft",
111	            details={"status": bom.status},
112	        )
113	    data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
114	    if data.get("uom_id") is not None:
115	        await _require_uom(session, tenant_id, data["uom_id"])
116	    for field, value in data.items():
117	        setattr(bom, field, value)
118	    await session.flush()
119	    return bom
120	
121	
122	async def list_boms(
123	    session: AsyncSession,
124	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
125	    *,
126	    item_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
127	    status: BomStatus | None = None,
128	    cursor: str | None = None,
129	    limit: int = DEFAULT_LIMIT,
130	) -> Page[Bom]:
131	    """Keyset-paginated BOMs ordered by (item_id, version) (D-014). The item/status filters narrow
132	    the set (index-served by (tenant, item_id, status)) and fold into the cursor fingerprint."""
133	    stmt = select(Bom).where(Bom.tenant_id == tenant_id)
134	    if item_id is not None:
135	        stmt = stmt.where(Bom.item_id == item_id)
136	    if status is not None:
137	        stmt = stmt.where(Bom.status == status.value)
138	    fingerprint = filter_fingerprint(item_id, status)
139	    return await paginate(
140	        session,
141	        stmt,
142	        order_by=[
143	            OrderKey(Bom.item_id, SortDirection.ASC),
144	            OrderKey(Bom.version, SortDirection.ASC),
145	        ],
146	        pk=Bom.id,
147	        cursor=cursor,
148	        limit=limit,
149	        filters=fingerprint,
150	    )
151	
152	
153	# --- Components ----------------------------------------------------------------
154	
155	
156	async def bom_components_for(
157	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bom_id: uuid.UUID
158	) -> list[BomComponent]:
159	    """The components of a BOM, ordered by line_number (the read helper 8.2/8.3 + the nested list
160	    use). One indexed read by (tenant, bom_id)."""
161	    stmt = (
162	        select(BomComponent)
163	        .where(BomComponent.tenant_id == tenant_id, BomComponent.bom_id == bom_id)
164	        .order_by(BomComponent.line_number)
165	    )
166	    return list((await session.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
167	
168	
169	async def add_component(
170	    session: AsyncSession,
171	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
172	    bom_id: uuid.UUID,
173	    payload: BomComponentCreate,
174	) -> BomComponent:
175	    """Add a component to a DRAFT BOM (D-047). Validates the BOM is DRAFT, the component item + UoM
176	    exist, the component is not the parent item (no self-reference), and the line_number is free
177	    (appends the next line when omitted)."""
178	    bom = await get_bom(session, tenant_id, bom_id)
179	    if bom.status != BomStatus.DRAFT.value:
180	        raise ConflictError(
181	            message="Components can be changed only while the BOM is DRAFT",
182	            code="manufacturing.bom_not_draft",
183	            details={"status": bom.status},
184	        )
185	    if payload.component_item_id == bom.item_id:
186	        raise ValidationFailedError(
187	            message="A BOM component cannot be the BOM's own parent item",
188	            code="manufacturing.bom_self_component",
189	            details={"item_id": str(bom.item_id)},
190	        )
191	    await _require_item(session, tenant_id, payload.component_item_id)
192	    await _require_uom(session, tenant_id, payload.uom_id)
193	    line_number = payload.line_number
194	    if line_number is None:
195	        max_line = (
196	            await session.execute(
197	                select(func.coalesce(func.max(BomComponent.line_number), 0)).where(
198	                    BomComponent.tenant_id == tenant_id, BomComponent.bom_id == bom_id
199	                )
200	            )
201	        ).scalar_one()
202	        line_number = int(max_line) + 10
203	    else:
204	        clash = (
205	            await session.execute(
206	                select(BomComponent.id).where(
207	                    BomComponent.tenant_id == tenant_id,
208	                    BomComponent.bom_id == bom_id,
209	                    BomComponent.line_number == line_number,
210	                )
211	            )
212	        ).first()
213	        if clash is not None:
214	            raise ConflictError(
215	                message=f"Line number {line_number} already exists on this BOM",
216	                code="manufacturing.bom_line_conflict",
217	                details={"line_number": line_number},
218	            )
219	    component = BomComponent(
220	        tenant_id=tenant_id,
221	        bom_id=bom_id,
222	        line_number=line_number,
223	        component_item_id=payload.component_item_id,
224	        quantity_per=payload.quantity_per,
225	        uom_id=payload.uom_id,
226	        scrap_percent=payload.scrap_percent,
227	        notes=payload.notes,
228	    )
229	    session.add(component)
230	    await session.flush()
231	    return component
232	
233	
234	async def delete_component(
235	    session: AsyncSession,
236	    tenant_id: uuid.UUID,
237	    bom_id: uuid.UUID,
238	    component_id: uuid.UUID,
239	) -> None:
240	    """Delete a component from a DRAFT BOM (D-047). A non-DRAFT BOM is frozen (ConflictError). The
241	    component must belong to the named BOM."""
242	    bom = await get_bom(session, tenant_id, bom_id)
243	    if bom.status != BomStatus.DRAFT.value:
244	        raise ConflictError(
245	            message="Components can be changed only while the BOM is DRAFT",
246	            code="manufacturing.bom_not_draft",
247	            details={"status": bom.status},
248	        )
249	    component = await session.get(BomComponent, component_id)
250	    if (
251	        component is None
252	        or component.tenant_id != tenant_id
253	        or component.bom_id != bom_id
254	    ):
255	        raise NotFoundError(
256	            message="BOM component not found", code="manufacturing.bom_component_not_found"
257	        )
258	    await session.delete(component)
259	    await session.flush()
260	
261	
262	# --- Activation ----------------------------------------------------------------
263	
264	
265	async def activate_bom(
266	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bom_id: uuid.UUID
267	) -> Bom:
268	    """Activate a DRAFT BOM (D-047): it becomes the item's ACTIVE default and is frozen. Requires at
269	    least one component (an empty BOM produces nothing). Demotes the previously-default ACTIVE
270	    version's ``is_default`` flag so exactly one default-active version exists per item. Activating
271	    an already-ACTIVE BOM is idempotent; activating an INACTIVE BOM is a ConflictError (reactivation
272	    is a new version)."""
273	    bom = await get_bom(session, tenant_id, bom_id)
274	    if bom.status == BomStatus.ACTIVE.value:
275	        return bom
276	    if bom.status != BomStatus.DRAFT.value:
277	        raise ConflictError(
278	            message="Only a DRAFT BOM can be activated",
279	            code="manufacturing.bom_not_activatable",
280	            details={"status": bom.status},
281	        )
282	    components = await bom_components_for(session, tenant_id, bom_id)
283	    if not components:
284	        raise ValidationFailedError(
285	            message="A BOM must have at least one component before it can be activated",
286	            code="manufacturing.bom_no_components",
287	        )
288	    # Demote the current default-active version for this item (mutate the loaded object so the audit
289	    # diff is captured — D-010, never a bulk update).
290	    current_default = (
291	        await session.execute(
292	            select(Bom).where(
293	                Bom.tenant_id == tenant_id,
294	                Bom.item_id == bom.item_id,
295	                Bom.status == BomStatus.ACTIVE.value,
296	                Bom.is_default.is_(True),
297	                Bom.id != bom.id,
298	            )
299	        )
300	    ).scalar_one_or_none()
301	    if current_default is not None:
302	        current_default.is_default = False
303	    bom.status = BomStatus.ACTIVE.value
304	    bom.is_default = True
305	    await session.flush()
306	    return bom
307	
308	
309	async def deactivate_bom(
310	    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID, bom_id: uuid.UUID
311	) -> Bom:
312	    """Deactivate an ACTIVE BOM (D-047): it becomes INACTIVE and loses the default flag, so the item
313	    has no active default until another version is activated. Deactivating a non-ACTIVE BOM is a
314	    ConflictError."""
315	    bom = await get_bom(session, tenant_id, bom_id)
316	    if bom.status != BomStatus.ACTIVE.value:
317	        raise ConflictError(
318	            message="Only an ACTIVE BOM can be deactivated",
319	            code="manufacturing.bom_not_active",
320	            details={"status": bom.status},
321	        )
322	    bom.status = BomStatus.INACTIVE.value
323	    bom.is_default = False
324	    await session.flush()
325	    return bom

1	"""BOM HTTP layer (thin): parse -> call service -> return schema (PLAN 8.1).
2	
3	A sibling sub-router (mounted into the module router) so each router file stays under the STRUCTURE
4	§3 400-line cap — the finance ap_router / inventory stock_router include precedent. REST under the
5	``/api/v1/manufacturing`` prefix the parent router owns: BOM header CRUD + filtered list, the
6	activate/deactivate actions, and the nested components GET/POST/DELETE. Every route is guarded by a
7	manufacturing permission key (D-009). Writes commit through ``run_in_uow`` (D-011) so audit rows
8	ride the same transaction; results are validated into their Read schema AFTER the uow commits.
9	
10	The BOM list is semi-reference data, so it carries a conditional-GET ETag (PERFORMANCE §3 / D-035)
11	with the item/status filters folded into the request fingerprint.
12	"""
13	
14	import uuid
15	from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
16	
17	from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request, Response
18	
19	from app.core.conditional import collection_etag, conditional_response, request_fingerprint
20	from app.core.deps import CurrentUserDep, SessionDep
21	from app.core.events import run_in_uow
22	from app.core.pagination import CursorParams, cursor_params, map_page
23	from app.core.rbac import require_permission
24	from app.core.schemas import Page
25	from app.modules.manufacturing import service
26	from app.modules.manufacturing.constants import MFG_BOM_MANAGE, MFG_BOM_READ, BomStatus
27	from app.modules.manufacturing.models import Bom
28	from app.modules.manufacturing.schemas import (
29	    BomComponentCreate,
30	    BomComponentRead,
31	    BomCreate,
32	    BomRead,
33	    BomUpdate,
34	)

36	bom_router = APIRouter()
37	_CursorParamsDep = Depends(cursor_params)
38	
39	
40	async def _commit[T](session: SessionDep, work: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:
41	    """Run a service call inside the D-011 uow, returning its ORM result refreshed in the async
42	    context so a sync ``model_validate`` never trips MissingGreenlet (the inventory _commit
43	    twin)."""
44	    holder: list[T] = []
45	
46	    async def _work() -> None:
47	        result = await work()
48	        await session.refresh(result)
49	        holder.append(result)
50	
51	    await run_in_uow(session, _work)
52	    return holder[0]
53	
54	
55	@bom_router.get(
56	    "/boms",
57	    response_model=Page[BomRead],
58	    dependencies=[Depends(require_permission(MFG_BOM_READ))],
59	)
60	async def list_boms(
61	    request: Request,
62	    response: Response,
63	    current: CurrentUserDep,
64	    session: SessionDep,
65	    params: CursorParams = _CursorParamsDep,
66	    item_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
67	    status: BomStatus | None = None,
68	) -> Page[BomRead] | Response:
69	    """Conditional-GET supported (D-035): the item/status filters fold into the fingerprint so a
70	    filtered 304 is correct."""
71	    fingerprint = request_fingerprint(params.cursor, params.limit, item_id, status)
72	    etag = await collection_etag(session, Bom, request_fingerprint=fingerprint)
73	
74	    async def builder() -> Page[BomRead]:
75	        page = await service.list_boms(
76	            session,
77	            current.tenant_id,
78	            item_id=item_id,
79	            status=status,
80	            cursor=params.cursor,
81	            limit=params.limit,
82	        )
83	        return map_page(page, BomRead)
84	
85	    return await conditional_response(request, response, etag, builder)
86

88	@bom_router.post(
89	    "/boms",
90	    response_model=BomRead,
91	    status_code=201,
92	    dependencies=[Depends(require_permission(MFG_BOM_MANAGE))],
93	)
94	async def create_bom(
95	    payload: BomCreate, current: CurrentUserDep, session: SessionDep
96	) -> BomRead:
97	    bom = await _commit(session, lambda: service.create_bom(session, current.tenant_id, payload))
98	    return BomRead.model_validate(bom)
99	
100	
101	@bom_router.get(
102	    "/boms/{bom_id}",
103	    response_model=BomRead,
104	    dependencies=[Depends(require_permission(MFG_BOM_READ))],
105	)
106	async def get_bom(
107	    bom_id: uuid.UUID, current: CurrentUserDep, session: SessionDep
108	) -> BomRead:
109	    bom = await service.get_bom(session, current.tenant_id, bom_id)
110	    return BomRead.model_validate(bom)
111	
112	
113	@bom_router.patch(
114	    "/boms/{bom_id}",
115	    response_model=BomRead,
116	    dependencies=[Depends(require_permission(MFG_BOM_MANAGE))],

127	    """Composite tenant-safe FK for a business table's ``document_id`` -> core_documents

137	class DocumentMixin:
138	    """Business-document link mixin (D-012). A business model mixes this in to get a NOT NULL
139	    ``document_id`` column tying its row to its registry entry — so the row CANNOT be inserted
140	    without first registering the document (the dual-write discipline D-012 relies on). The
141	    consuming model must also add ``document_fk()`` to its __table_args__ for the composite
142	    tenant-safe FK (a mixin cannot inject a multi-column FK into the host's __table_args__,
143	    exactly as TenantMixin needs the model to add tenant_fk()). UNIQUE so the registry-to-row
144	    mapping is 1:1.

    OVERRIDE — the GR/IR-override pattern, 6.3); its finished RECEIPT DEBITS inventory and CREDITS

    RAISES a clear 422 (``finance.posting_default_unmapped``) when unmapped — a production order
    cannot issue or finish without a WIP account to clear. Exposed on finance/queries so
    MANUFACTURING reads it downward (STRUCTURE §5) without importing finance/service (the GR/IR
    clearing mirror)."""
    return await _posting_defaults.get_posting_default(session, tenant_id, WIP_CLEARING)

    session: AsyncSession, tenant_id: uuid.UUID

    order's accumulated WIP debit (issued component cost) differs from the value entering finished

    cannot complete without it. Exposed on finance/queries so manufacturing reads it downward
    (STRUCTURE §5) without importing finance/service (the PPV mirror)."""

from app.core.rbac import register_permissions


class ProductionOrderStatus(StrEnum):
    """Lifecycle of a PRODUCTION ORDER (PLAN 8.2, D-048). A production order turns components into a
    finished parent item; its status tracks the issue→finish progress.

    Transitions (the service owns them, CLAUDE.md rule 7):

    - **DRAFT** — created + the active BOM EXPLODED into reserved component rows (and the routing
      snapshotted into order operations). Editable only via cancel; releasing moves it forward.
    - **RELEASED** — materials are reserved (the component rows ARE the reservation, v1 ATP-style —
      release does NOT block on availability, only optionally flags shortages). Ready to issue.
    - **IN_PROGRESS** — at least one component has been issued to WIP (Dr WIP / Cr Inventory). The
      order is mid-production: it can issue more components or finish.
    - **FINISHED** — the parent item has been fully produced to stock (Dr Inventory / Cr WIP) and the
      ordered quantity is met. Terminal; WIP nets to zero (issue debits = finished credit + variance
      flush).
    - **CANCELLED** — abandoned before any component issued (DRAFT/RELEASED only). Once components
      are issued the order is POSTED-ish: it must be FINISHED (a future phase adds reversal), never
      cancelled, so issued stock + WIP never strand. Terminal.
    """

    RELEASED = "RELEASED"
    IN_PROGRESS = "IN_PROGRESS"
    FINISHED = "FINISHED"
    CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"

input.content:
"""Production-order models (PLAN 8.2, parity PP production orders = FULL): the header, the exploded
component reservations, and the routing-snapshot operations.

A production order turns COMPONENTS into a FINISHED parent item: a header (``ProductionOrder``) plus
its ``ProductionOrderComponent`` rows (the BOM exploded at create time — required vs issued
quantity) and its ``ProductionOrderOperation`` rows (the routing snapshotted for 8.3's capacity
load). The header mixes in ``DocumentMixin`` (it registers in core_documents + claims an MO- number
at creation — a posted document, unlike the 8.1 masters).

All item/UoM/warehouse/bin ids are OPAQUE inventory ids (D-029): no cross-module FK to inventory
tables; the service validates each via ``inventory/queries`` before writing. The ``bom_id``/
``routing_id`` are INTRA-module composite tenant FKs to ``mfg_boms``/``mfg_routings`` (the exploded
version snapshots). Quantities use the D-015 QuantityType (scale-6, exact on both engines);
``accumulated_wip_cost`` uses MoneyType (the value side, quantized to currency).

``accumulated_wip_cost`` is the running WIP debit for this order: raised by each component issue (by
the posted issue cost) and consumed at finish to compute the finished unit cost — the SSOT for the
WIP-nets-to-zero invariant (D-048), maintained on the header rather than recomputed from the journal
so the finish flow has the figure in hand.
"""

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal

import sqlalchemy as sa
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.core.docflow import DocumentMixin, document_fk
from app.core.models import (
    AuditMixin,
    Base,
    TenantMixin,
    TimestampMixin,
    UuidPKMixin,
    tenant_fk,
    tenant_unique,
)
from app.core.money import MoneyType, QuantityType
from app.modules.manufacturing.constants import ProductionOrderStatus


class ProductionOrder(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, AuditMixin, DocumentMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
    """A PRODUCTION ORDER HEADER (D-048): the order to produce ``quantity`` of ``item_id``.

    ``item_id`` is the OPAQUE inventory parent item produced; ``bom_id`` is the INTRA-module BOM
    version EXPLODED into the component rows; ``routing_id`` (nullable) is the routing version
    snapshotted into the operation rows. ``warehouse_id`` is where components are issued FROM and the
    finished goods land. ``status`` runs the ``ProductionOrderStatus`` lifecycle. ``finished_quantity``
    is raised at finish (0 until then); ``accumulated_wip_cost`` is the running WIP debit (raised by
    each issue, consumed at finish) — the WIP-nets-to-zero SSOT (D-048). Registers a document + claims
    the gapless MO- number at creation (D-012). Audited (D-010): a production order drives stock + GL
    effects.
    """

    __tablename__ = "mfg_production_orders"
    __table_args__ = (
        tenant_unique(),
        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
        tenant_fk("mfg_boms", "bom_id"),
        tenant_fk("mfg_routings", "routing_id"),
        document_fk(),
        sa.UniqueConstraint(
            "tenant_id",
            "order_number",
            name="uq_mfg_production_orders_tenant_id_order_number",
        ),
        sa.CheckConstraint(
            "quantity > 0", name="ck_mfg_production_orders_quantity_positive"
        ),
        sa.CheckConstraint(
            "finished_quantity >= 0",
            name="ck_mfg_production_orders_finished_non_negative",
        ),
        # The list filters on (tenant, status) and an item's orders by status (PERFORMANCE §1); the
        # composite serves the filtered + paginated list and the open-orders scan.
        sa.Index(
            "ix_mfg_production_orders_tenant_id_status", "tenant_id", "status"
        ),
        sa.Index(
            "ix_mfg_production_orders_tenant_id_item_id", "tenant_id", "item_id"
        ),
    )

    order_number: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(sa.String(60), nullable=False)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(
        sa.String(20),
        nullable=False,
        default=ProductionOrderStatus.DRAFT.value,
        server_default="DRAFT",
    )
    # OPAQUE inventory item id (D-029): the parent item produced. No FK to inv_items.
    item_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    quantity: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(QuantityType(), nullable=False)
    # INTRA-module composite tenant FK to mfg_boms — the exploded version snapshot.
    bom_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    # INTRA-module composite tenant FK to mfg_routings — the routing snapshot (nullable: a routingless
    # order is allowed; it just snapshots no operations).
    routing_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=True)
    # OPAQUE inventory warehouse id (D-029): components issue from it; finished goods land in it.
    warehouse_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    planned_start_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(sa.Date, nullable=True)
    planned_end_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(sa.Date, nullable=True)
    finished_quantity: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        QuantityType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(0), server_default="0"
    )
    # The running WIP debit (D-048): raised by each component issue's posted cost, consumed at finish
    # to derive the finished unit cost. MoneyType (the value side, quantized to currency).
    accumulated_wip_cost: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        MoneyType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(0), server_default="0"
    )
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(sa.String(1000), nullable=True)
    released_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        sa.DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
    )
    finished_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(
        sa.DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True
    )


class ProductionOrderComponent(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
    """One EXPLODED, reserved component requirement of a production order (D-048).

    Snapshotted from the order's BOM at create time: ``component_item_id`` is the OPAQUE inventory
    material; ``required_quantity`` = quantity_per × order quantity × (1 + scrap_percent/100),
    quantized; ``issued_quantity`` is raised as materials are issued (0 until then — issued must not
    exceed required, v1 over-issue policy). ``bin_id`` is the OPAQUE bin the component is issued from
    (defaulted/settable). ``uom_id`` is the component's opaque UoM.

    NOT AuditMixin: components ride the order header's audit story (no independent lifecycle) — the
    BomComponent/sales-order-line precedent.
    """

    __tablename__ = "mfg_production_order_components"
    __table_args__ = (
        tenant_unique(),
        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
        tenant_fk("mfg_production_orders", "production_order_id"),
        sa.UniqueConstraint(
            "tenant_id",
            "production_order_id",
            "line_number",
            name="uq_mfg_po_components_tenant_id_production_order_id_line_number",
        ),
        sa.CheckConstraint(
            "required_quantity > 0",
            name="ck_mfg_po_components_required_positive",
        ),
        sa.CheckConstraint(
            "issued_quantity >= 0",
            name="ck_mfg_po_components_issued_non_negative",
        ),
        sa.Index(
            "ix_mfg_po_components_tenant_id_production_order_id",
            "tenant_id",
            "production_order_id",
        ),
    )

    production_order_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    line_number: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(sa.Integer, nullable=False)
    # OPAQUE inventory item id (D-029): the component material. No FK to inv_items.
    component_item_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    required_quantity: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(QuantityType(), nullable=False)
    issued_quantity: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        QuantityType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(0), server_default="0"
    )
    # OPAQUE inventory UoM id (D-029).
    uom_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    # OPAQUE inventory bin id (D-029): where this component is issued FROM.
    bin_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)


class ProductionOrderOperation(UuidPKMixin, TenantMixin, TimestampMixin, Base):
    """One routing-snapshot operation of a production order (D-048): the per-order operation load
    8.3's rough capacity check sums against a work centre.

    Snapshotted from the order's routing at create time: ``operation_number`` is the sequence,
    ``work_center_id`` the INTRA-module work centre, ``setup_time_minutes`` the fixed setup and
    ``run_time_minutes_per_unit`` the per-unit run. ``planned_minutes`` = setup + run × order quantity
    (precomputed at snapshot so 8.3 reads the per-order load directly). All times in MINUTES
    (QuantityType, scale-6, D-015).

    NOT AuditMixin: operations ride the order header's audit story (the RoutingOperation precedent).
    """

    __tablename__ = "mfg_production_order_operations"
    __table_args__ = (
        tenant_unique(),
        tenant_fk("adm_tenants"),
        tenant_fk("mfg_production_orders", "production_order_id"),
        tenant_fk("mfg_work_centers", "work_center_id"),
        sa.UniqueConstraint(
            "tenant_id",
            "production_order_id",
            "operation_number",
            name="uq_mfg_po_operations_tenant_id_production_order_id_operation_number",
        ),
        sa.CheckConstraint(
            "planned_minutes >= 0", name="ck_mfg_po_operations_planned_non_negative"
        ),
        sa.Index(
            "ix_mfg_po_operations_tenant_id_production_order_id",
            "tenant_id",
            "production_order_id",
        ),
        # The "operations at this work centre" read path (8.3 work-centre load aggregation).
        sa.Index(
            "ix_mfg_po_operations_tenant_id_work_center_id",
            "tenant_id",
            "work_center_id",
        ),
    )

    production_order_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    operation_number: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(sa.Integer, nullable=False)
    work_center_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(sa.Uuid, nullable=False)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(sa.String(1000), nullable=True)
    setup_time_minutes: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        QuantityType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(0), server_default="0"
    )
    run_time_minutes_per_unit: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        QuantityType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(0), server_default="0"
    )
    planned_minutes: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(
        QuantityType(), nullable=False, default=Decimal(0), server_default="0"
    )
